# Jax Systems
> Jacksonville-based AI help for small businesses.

Primary site: https://jaxsystems.ai/
Primary contact route: https://jaxsystems.ai/contact

Current public offer:
- Start with one free working session: one question, one of seven business areas, up to 60 minutes, owner or decision-maker present, one session per business.
- Path A: $2,499 for one agreed improvement after a signed scope card covering the trigger, end state, tools, rules, exclusions, tests, owner, and price.
- Path B: $999 Business Improvement Plan covering all seven areas at a high level, with ranked opportunities, measurement, and one implementation blueprint. The $999 credit applies in full to Path A, leaving $1,500.
- Optional support: $499/month for the agreed improvement after launch.
- Eligible extra improvement: $1,500 when it reuses the approved setup and access. Eligible live extra support: $250/month.
- The seven areas are Offer, Marketing, Sales, Delivery and customer experience, Retention, Operations and people, and Finance.
